title: Microsoft Azure Online Training
description:
About MICROSOFT AZURE Online Training:

As Microsoft Azure Online Training Cloud Computing is ramping up in no time and most of the highest companies started using it, many roles are becoming created on the Azure platform. Compared to other skill sets, chances for getting jobs for the Azure professionals are higher.

Microsoft Azure may be a set of cloud services that helps your company develop, deploy, and architect applications on an enormous global network using your preferred frameworks and tools. Azure offers infrastructure as a service (IaaS), platform as a service (PaaS), and software as a service (SaaS). It also provides multi-layered security across physical data centres, operations, and infrastructure with cybersecurity experts monitoring actively to safeguard your business data.

When compared with other cloud providers, Azure is out there during a number of regions. It offers various solutions that meet the requirements of your business or application. The products and services that Azure provides include AI capabilities for Azure, Azure Blockchain Service, Azure Kubernetes Service, App Service, PlayFab, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, Virtual Machines, connecting IoT devices to Azure cloud, Azure Sphere, and Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Lake, Azure HDInsight, and lots of more.

Prerequisites

Following are the pre-requisites for Microsoft Azure Online Training:

  • Knowledge of operating systems
  • Knowledge of networking
  • Knowledge of .NET
  • Knowledge of cloud computing
  • Knowledge of SQL database
